scope: Read-only High live 0.0.45 rest audits and same-camera fir still repeats; software WebGL, no hardware timing or fresh motion metric claim.

audits.scope: Registered forest selected-LOD rest geometry. Leaf components link by bounding-box proximity, then leaf-surface samples test wood-triangle contacts. Alpha cutout is evaluated only in alpha mode (opaque-texel bounds); shader wind is not; candidates require visual review. Null sampled gap means no nearby triangle was found, not an exact distance.
